From Warner Bros. Pictures and Legendary Pictures comes Dune: Part Three, bringing Academy Award-nominated filmmaker Denis Villeneuve’s epic trilogy to a breathtaking conclusion.

Dune: Part Three is set nearly two decades after Paul Atreides seized control of the Imperium. Now a ruthless Emperor, Paul must face the consequences of his reign as old allies return, terrifying new threats emerge, and betrayal lurks in every shadow. Haunted by visions of Imperial collapse and the reappearance of his long-lost love, Paul is drawn into a sweeping conspiracy, with Chani at the heart of its unfolding mystery. As rebellion brews and enemies close in, Paul must confront the true cost of power and the fate of those he loves the most.

Villeneuve directs from a screenplay by Villeneuve and Brian K. Vaughan, based on the novels written by Frank Herbert. snippet.title: AURE GOMA OFFICIAL TRAILER
snippet.description:
AURE GOMA is a captivating political drama that follows the extraordinary journey of a man whose life becomes defined by a series of controversial marriages and divorces. Over the years, he marries ten different women, and each marriage ends in separation. To society, he is judged as an irresponsible husband who cannot sustain a home. However, hidden behind every failed marriage is a truth far more complex than anyone could imagine.

Despite enduring public ridicule, emotional pain, and personal setbacks, he refuses to give up on life. His fortunes begin to change when a wealthy, influential, and compassionate businessman recognizes his potential and takes him under his wing. Through mentorship, support, and opportunity, he rises from hardship to become a successful entrepreneur and one of the most respected figures in his community.

His growing popularity and reputation eventually draw him into politics, where his sincerity, leadership qualities, and connection with ordinary people earn him widespread admiration. Before long, he emerges as a leading gubernatorial candidate, inspiring hope among thousands who believe he represents a new future.

But as victory draws near, powerful political rivals launch a ruthless campaign to destroy his credibility. They dig into his past and expose his history of ten divorces, turning it into a national scandal. The media erupts, public opinion becomes divided, and his political future hangs in the balance.

Faced with the greatest challenge of his life, he must confront his past and reveal the painful truths behind each marriage. As secrets unfold and hidden sacrifices come to light, the public begins to question everything they thought they knew about him.

AURE GOMA is a powerful story of love, sacrifice, resilience, redemption, and the price of leadership. It explores how society often judges people without knowing their struggles, and how the truth can ultimately triumph over deception, prejudice, and political manipulation.
